final_wiki.answer-Q-8095-A84:
The greatest common divisor (GCD) of 420 and 720 can be found using the **Euclidean algorithm** or by factoring both numbers into their prime factors.

- Prime factors of 420: 2<sup>2</sup> × 3 × 5 × 7
- Prime factors of 720: 2<sup>4</sup> × 3<sup>2</sup> × 5

Taking the lowest power of each common prime factor:
- 2<sup>2</sup> × 3 × 5 = **60**.
